name: win_route
description: Slice default (V4: one marching enemy archer in shown lane 4). Hold the back row for three turns while the enemy marches to column 4. On turn 4 (the enemy strikes first) step forward to column 1: the enemy also steps to column 3 and the first exchange happens with the enemy shooting first (player 4 -> 1, enemy 4 -> 1). On turn 5 the player strikes first; the enemy sees the player in range and stays, so the player's arrow kills it before it can shoot again. Elimination win, no tie rule needed.
target_format: [col, lane] zero-based, or null = hold fire / no target
